title: Sr Staff Software Engineer
description: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: PayPal is modernizing its core platforms onto Google Cloud, and data is at the center of that change. We are looking for a Senior Staff Architect to be the data architecture expert for Core Platforms, setting data standards that apply across risk, compliance, identity, privacy, servicing, and checkout platforms rather than within any single one. You will turn regulatory and business data requirements into architecture standards that every platform implements the same way, own the target-state architecture for analytics on cloud, and anchor architecture leadership in APAC hours, running forums and reviews in your own time zone. You will work with data engineering and migration teams, and with enterprise data architects, to keep one coherent data architecture as platforms move to the cloud. Job Description: Essential Responsibilities: Makes technical decisions affecting multiple teams, crossing organizational boundaries Establishes conventions & processes to be followed by other employees Actions determine the utilization of company resources (people, money, assets) and affect the effectiveness of the company Handles multiple, multi-team initiatives simultaneously, using judgement to prioritize among more issues than can be handled individually. Understands evolving industry capabilities & practices and can judiciously apply up -to-date information for optimal results Competent at communicating technical issues with non-technical audiences Spreads their behavior, principles, and knowledge as a means of improving technical results of other employees (via many means – modeling behavior, 1:1s, working sessions, quality documentation) Partners with product management, to ideate solutions to business problems & goals Minimum Qualifications: 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications : Roles & Responsibilities Lead data architecture and governance for Core Platforms by defining outcomes for others, refining the process, and giving senior leaders technical advice on systems, trade-offs, and strategy. Translate regulatory and business data requirements, such as risk data aggregation and reporting, data residency, and classification, into architecture standards that all platforms implement consistently. Own the target-state architecture for analytics on cloud, including migration from legacy relational databases to a cloud data warehouse, a domain data product model, and standards for data flowing into and out of analytical stores. Define data classification, lineage, and retention standards, and publish data localization patterns for the markets in scope. Resolve unclear data ownership and roles across data, identity, and compliance architects, and drive conflicting positions to a documented decision. Support data and migration engineering teams with architecture patterns for regulated and stateful workloads moving to the cloud. Run architecture forums and review cadences in APAC hours, and keep them working without senior leadership present for routine sessions. Triage incoming architecture requests and manage the architecture decision record pipeline, including queue, cadence, and library. Influence peer architects and engineering leaders across domains without direct authority, and mentor architects and engineers in India on architecture practice and decision quality. Minimum qualifications Minimum of 12 years of relevant work experience and a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. At least 3 years in an architecture capacity at the Staff, Senior Staff, or equivalent level. Data architecture depth across relational databases, cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, pipeline design, and governance frameworks, with sound judgment on data product models, lineage, and retention. Regulatory data fluency, including risk data aggregation standards, data residency, and data classification, and the ability to turn a requirement into an architecture constraint. Experience running recurring architecture forums, a decision record process, and architecture intake at scale, not only attending them. Demonstrated success in ambiguous, high-complexity programs, taking a fragmented or unowned data problem to a ratified standard. Demonstrated record of influencing peers and senior leaders without direct authority. Availability to work APAC hours with a daily overlap with San Jose, California. Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining data trade-offs to non-technical leaders. Preferred qualifications: Experience with data localization requirements across APAC markets. Experience partnering with an enterprise architecture data function. Cloud architecture depth sufficient to run architecture forums locally. Prior knowledge of payments, risk, compliance, or identity platforms.
